about: The Ultimate Challenge's own rounds: never played on the Board or in Defuse. Cambridge formats only, written around the traps B2 First actually sets.

rounds.prompt: Not until the lights came back on ___ how much damage the storm had done.
rounds.note: Not until + time clause: the inversion goes in the MAIN clause — did we realise.

rounds.prompt: Little ___ that her own brother had organised the surprise party.
rounds.note: Little at the start means 'not at all': little + did + subject + verb.

rounds.prompt: Seldom ___ such a talented young player at this club.
rounds.note: Seldom + auxiliary + subject: have we had.

rounds.prompt: No sooner had the referee blown the whistle ___ the fans ran onto the pitch.
rounds.note: No sooner always pairs with THAN (Hardly and Scarcely take when).

rounds.prompt: Hardly had I sat down ___ the phone rang again.
rounds.note: Hardly / Scarcely … when. Than belongs to no sooner.

rounds.prompt: ___ you need any help with your project, just send me a message.
rounds.note: Should you … = If you happen to … (a first conditional, inverted).

rounds.prompt: ___ we left ten minutes earlier, we wouldn't have missed the start.
rounds.note: Had we left = If we had left (third conditional, inverted).

rounds.prompt: ___ I in your position, I'd apologise to her straight away.
rounds.note: Were I … = If I were … — only were inverts, never was.

rounds.prompt: Not only ___ the exam, but she also got the highest mark in the class.
rounds.note: Not only + did + subject + verb, then but … also.

rounds.prompt: Only after the third attempt ___ to open the old suitcase.
rounds.note: Only after … : the main clause inverts — did they manage.

rounds.prompt: 'I can't stand horror films.' '___ can I.'
rounds.note: Agreeing with a negative: Neither / Nor + auxiliary + subject.

rounds.prompt: My brother loves surfing, and ___ my cousins.
rounds.note: So + auxiliary that matches the verb (loves → do) and the subject (my cousins → plural).

rounds.prompt: At no time ___ that the exam would be cancelled.
rounds.note: At no time + inversion; here the verb is passive, so were we told.

rounds.prompt: Only when you've tried it yourself ___ how hard it is.
rounds.note: Only when + clause, then the main clause inverts: will you understand.

rounds.prompt: Never before ___ so many people at a school concert.
rounds.note: Never before + past perfect, inverted: had I seen.

rounds.prompt: Rarely ___ late, so when he didn't arrive we started to worry.
rounds.note: Rarely + be + subject; past context, so was he.

rounds.prompt: Not ___ did he say sorry, he also paid for the damage.
rounds.note: Not only did he … : the first half of not only … but also.

rounds.prompt: No sooner had we arrived ___ it started to pour with rain.
rounds.note: No sooner … than.

rounds.prompt: ___ had the film started when the power went off.
rounds.note: Hardly / Scarcely / Barely had … when.

rounds.prompt: Under ___ circumstances should you share your password.
rounds.note: Under no circumstances + inversion: never, in any situation.

rounds.prompt: Only ___ the end of the match did the team relax.
rounds.note: Only at the end … did they relax: the preposition, then the inversion.

rounds.prompt: Little ___ I know that I would end up living in Lisbon.
rounds.note: Little did I know … — the auxiliary did.

rounds.prompt: ___ it not for her help, I would never finish this project.
rounds.note: Were it not for = If it weren't for (second conditional).

rounds.prompt: Had it not ___ for the rain, we would have gone to the beach.
rounds.note: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for (third conditional).

rounds.prompt: Not ___ I got home did I notice that I'd lost my keys.
rounds.note: Not until + clause, then did I notice.

rounds.prompt: I've never been to Paris, and neither ___ my sister.
rounds.note: Neither + the auxiliary of the first clause (have → has for my sister).

rounds.prompt: She can't swim, and ___ can her brother.
rounds.note: Agreeing with a negative: neither / nor can her brother.

rounds.prompt: So tired ___ she that she fell asleep on the bus.
rounds.note: So + adjective + be + subject + that …

rounds.prompt: Only by working together ___ we solve this problem.
rounds.note: Only by + -ing, then a modal before the subject.

rounds.prompt: Never ___ I been so embarrassed in my life!
rounds.note: Never have I been … — present perfect, inverted.

rounds.prompt: I had no idea the test would be so hard.
rounds.stem: ___ the test would be so hard.
rounds.note: Little did I know = I had no idea.

rounds.prompt: As soon as we got to the beach, it began to rain.
rounds.stem: No ___ to the beach than it began to rain.
rounds.note: No sooner had + subject + past participle … than.

rounds.prompt: You must not touch the exhibits in any situation.
rounds.stem: Under ___ touch the exhibits.
rounds.note: Under no circumstances + modal + subject.

rounds.prompt: If you happen to see Tom, tell him to call me.
rounds.stem: ___ Tom, tell him to call me.
rounds.note: Should you see = If you happen to see.

rounds.prompt: If I had known about the party, I would have gone.
rounds.stem: ___ about the party, I would have gone.
rounds.note: Had I known = If I had known.

rounds.prompt: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.
rounds.stem: ___, I'd accept the offer.
rounds.note: Were I you = If I were you.

rounds.prompt: She sings beautifully and she also writes her own songs.
rounds.stem: Not ___ beautifully, but she also writes her own songs.
rounds.note: Not only does she sing … but she also …

rounds.prompt: I didn't realise how serious the problem was until I read the report.
rounds.stem: Not ___ the report did I realise how serious the problem was.
rounds.note: Not until I read … did I realise.

rounds.prompt: We have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
rounds.stem: ___ such a beautiful sunset.
rounds.note: Never have we seen … — the auxiliary before the subject.

rounds.prompt: He hardly ever misses a training session.
rounds.stem: ___ a training session.
rounds.note: Rarely does he miss — does carries the tense, miss stays bare.

rounds.prompt: The moment I walked in, everyone started laughing.
rounds.stem: ___ in when everyone started laughing.
rounds.note: Hardly had I walked in when …

rounds.prompt: I don't like spicy food, and my brother doesn't like it either.
rounds.stem: I don't like spicy food, and ___.
rounds.note: Neither + does + subject.

rounds.prompt: Students can use the gym after school but not before.
rounds.stem: ___ students use the gym.
rounds.note: Only after school can students … — only + time, then the modal before the subject.

rounds.prompt: Nobody told us at any point that the trip was cancelled.
rounds.stem: At no ___ that the trip was cancelled.
rounds.note: At no time were we told — passive, inverted.

rounds.prompt: The storm was so strong that the bridge had to be closed.
rounds.stem: ___ that the bridge had to be closed.
rounds.note: So + adjective + was + subject + that …

rounds.prompt: If it hadn't been for your advice, I would have failed.
rounds.stem: ___ your advice, I would have failed.
rounds.note: Had it not been for = If it hadn't been for. Never 'hadn't it been'.

rounds.prompt: Rarely ___ such a talented young player.
rounds.note: Rarely + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Not only ___ the exam, but she got the top mark.
rounds.note: Not only + did + subject.

rounds.prompt: No sooner had the film started ___ the power went off.
rounds.note: No sooner … than.

rounds.prompt: Hardly had I closed my eyes ___ the alarm rang.
rounds.note: Hardly … when.

rounds.prompt: Only when I got home ___ I'd lost my wallet.
rounds.note: Only when … + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Under no circumstances ___ the door to strangers.
rounds.note: Under no circumstances + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Little ___ what was about to happen.
rounds.note: Little did they know.

rounds.prompt: Never before ___ so nervous.
rounds.note: Never before + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Not until the next morning ___ the truth.
rounds.note: Not until + inversion.

rounds.prompt: So beautiful ___ that everyone stopped to look.
rounds.note: So + adjective + be + subject.

rounds.prompt: Seldom ___ so much rain in October.
rounds.note: Seldom + do + subject.

rounds.prompt: On no account ___ leave your bag unattended.
rounds.note: On no account + inversion.

rounds.prompt: I can't swim, and neither ___ my brother.
rounds.note: Neither + positive auxiliary.

rounds.prompt: She loves sushi, and so ___ I.
rounds.note: So + auxiliary + subject.

rounds.prompt: Only then ___ how serious the problem was.
rounds.note: Only then + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Not once ___ me for help.
rounds.note: Not once + inversion.

rounds.prompt: Such ___ the noise that nobody could sleep.
rounds.note: Such + be + noun + that.

rounds.prompt: At no point ___ that she was lying.
rounds.note: At no point + inversion.

rounds.prompt: No sooner ___ we arrived than it started to rain.
rounds.note: No sooner had + subject.

rounds.prompt: Never ___ I seen such a mess!
rounds.note: Never have I seen.

rounds.prompt: Not ___ did he lie, but he also stole money.
rounds.note: Not only … but also.

rounds.prompt: Hardly had she sat down ___ the phone rang.
rounds.note: Hardly … when.

rounds.prompt: I haven't finished, and ___ has Tom.
rounds.note: Neither / nor + auxiliary.

rounds.prompt: Only after midnight ___ the party end.
rounds.note: Only after + did + subject.

rounds.prompt: I have rarely eaten such good food.
rounds.stem: ___ such good food.
rounds.note: Rarely + have + subject.

rounds.prompt: As soon as we left, it started snowing.
rounds.stem: No sooner ___ than it started snowing.
rounds.note: No sooner had we left … than.

rounds.prompt: She didn't understand until she read the letter.
rounds.stem: Not until she read the letter ___.
rounds.note: Not until … did she.

rounds.prompt: You must not open this box under any circumstances.
rounds.stem: On no ___ this box.
rounds.note: On no account + inversion.

rounds.prompt: He was so tired that he fell asleep at dinner.
rounds.stem: ___ that he fell asleep at dinner.
rounds.note: So + adjective + was + subject.

rounds.prompt: He didn't know that we were watching.
rounds.stem: ___ that we were watching.
rounds.note: Little did he know.
